newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Great Eagle says office demand stronger.
newsitem.headline: Great Eagle says office demand stronger.

text.p: Great Eagle Holdings Ltd said demand for quality Grade A office and commercial properties had strengthened recently and rental rates had been increasing.

The company, which announced in a statement published on Monday that it had decided not to proceed with a proposed spin off of its office and commercial property arm Tai Shan Properties Ltd, said its Great Eagle Centre was virtually fully occupied and its Citibank Plaza office tower was currently about 98 percent occupied.
It said Great Eagle shares were currently trading at a 43 percent discount to underlying net asset value of about HK$50.90 per share. Great Eagle shares closed at HK$29.05 on Friday.
